name: fulraikiri
notes: Backend: crates/fulgur-raikiri (Raikiri layout from crates.io raikiri-html/raikiri-net/raikiri-traits 0.0.6, Cargo.lock; painted with krilla 0.7). Not vendored. Pinned SHA = the Fulgur/Blitz adapter SHA; its 'raikiri backend' CI job (.github/workflows/raikiri.yml:86-140) passed at this commit, so no newer commit is needed. Render call mirrors crates/fulgur-dev/src/main.rs:81-114 for `--engine raikiri` without --stream: config.validate(), RenderOptions{assets: Some(&AssetBundle::new()), system_fonts: true, svg_rendering/svg_raster_scale from RenderOptions::default()} (fulgur-dev options.rs:65-66 builds an empty bundle when no --css/--font/--image), then fulgur_raikiri::render_with_options(input, &config, &options) (crates/fulgur-raikiri/src/lib.rs:25-47,67-73). Cargo: fulgur-raikiri and fulgur-core by path; raikiri-html/raikiri-net/raikiri-traits 0.0.6, url 2.5, log, serde_json, lopdf 0.45, libc (all in upstream Cargo.lock). The Linux fontique 0.11.1 dependency with fontconfig-dlopen is copied from crates/fulgur-dev/Cargo.toml so the fontconfig build mode matches the configuration upstream CI tests. page_rule: true. The config page size is the PageDefaults page box, used when @page size is absent, auto, or an orientation alone (lib.rs:298-318). Config margins become a user-origin @page rule that author @page margins override (lib.rs:320-347). Margin boxes are painted (paint/mod.rs:100-125, paint/margin.rs). default_page_size_config: true. The adapter builds Config{page_size: W*0.75 x H*0.75 pt, margin: Margin::uniform(M*0.75 pt), ..Config::default()} with Config::overrides left false (fulgur-core config.rs:154-206). ConfigBuilder::page_size/margin are not used because they set overrides to true (config.rs:310-320), which makes the size/margin !important over author @page (lib.rs:334-347). local_resources: partial. The base is the file:// URL of the input inside its canonical parent dir (files.rs:23-66). Stylesheets, @import, fonts and images are read only when the canonical path is inside that dir; ../ and absolute paths outside it are refused, and so is every non-file scheme (files.rs:81-108). There is a 32 MiB per-resource cap (raikiri-html resources.rs:52). Unlike Blitz, no image bundling is needed. system_fonts: true. No bundled fonts gives assets::fonts = None (assets.rs:10-19), so text uses raikiri_dom::system_font_collection (raikiri-html resources.rs:283-288; raikiri-dom fonts.rs:765) through shodo 'system-fonts', which is fontique/system with fontconfig (raikiri-html Cargo.toml shodo features; fontique-0.11.1 Cargo.toml). The default family is sans-serif via a user @layer rule (lib.rs:282-296). font_face: partial. @font-face url() is loaded through the same sandboxed provider (raikiri-html resources/network.rs:233-288). WOFF/WOFF2 are decoded with wuff (raikiri-dom fonts.rs:1-10). fulgur-raikiri has no test for this. geometry: partial. A second, adapter-side layout replicates fulgur-raikiri with_resources/with_layout (lib.rs:200-280), which are private, using the same user stylesheets, page defaults, provider, image resolver and border_width_device_scale(Some(1.0)). It then emits DocumentLayout::pages() -> Page::geometry().page_box and Page::fragments() (raikiri-html document_layout/mod.rs:344-358, page.rs:212-236). Each box is Fragment::rect(), the border box in page-local CSS px from the page-box top-left (raikiri-dom page_projection/fragment.rs:44-116). Text fragments and nodes without an element name are skipped. Tag/id/class come from Page::dom() (dom_view.rs:77-90). Caveats: rects are in layout space, before CSS transforms and relative offsets (fragment.rs:109-116). Repeated fragments (fixed elements, table header/footer repeats) appear on every page. Margin-box content is not included. diagnostics: partial. Structured DocumentLayout::warnings() from the analysis layout (mod.rs:434-437) carry WarningKind (raikiri-traits error.rs:306-429: HtmlParseError, NetworkFallback, ResourceFallback, ResolverFallback, ResourceLimitExceeded, TextRunsOmitted, PaintOrderApproximated, ...). They are written as kind 'raikiri:' with details, the variant payload and the node label. log::warn records (fulgur-core asset.rs) are captured as ':'. Raikiri's internal font/layout warn events without an observer go only to stderr via eprintln (raikiri-dom diag.rs:56-71) and are not captured. javascript: false (no JS engine in the dependency tree). svg: partial. Inline SVG is drawn as a vector scene or through the Krilla SVG fallback (README.md:144-161, paint/svg.rs:38-62). SVG used as an image (, background, list marker, content url()) is drawn as a vector (paint/raster.rs:221-278, src/tests/svg_image_tests.rs:1-3). External references and filters inside SVG return errors (README.md:159-161). images: partial. The decoders are image 0.25 with gif/jpeg/png/webp (raikiri-net Cargo.toml) and EXIF orientation (image_decoder.rs). The README documents PNG/JPEG (README.md:132-142). There is no AVIF. Missing images fall back to 0x0 with a ResolverFallback warning (images.rs:15-24). Stdout: an fd-1 to fd-2 isolator, copied from the Fulgur adapter, is a precaution. No println! was found in fulgur-raikiri, fulgur-core, raikiri-* or shodo non-test code. Page count is lopdf::Document::load_mem(..).get_pages().len(). Toolchain: workspace edition 2024, rust-version 1.89.0. There is no rust-toolchain.toml, and upstream CI uses dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable. apt: fontconfig is needed at runtime: fontconfig-dlopen loads libfontconfig.so.1 (yeslogic-fontconfig-sys 6.0.0). libfontconfig1-dev and pkg-config are kept for the non-dlopen build path.
